messages.subject: Part 36 offer - HT-2026-000214
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Gallagher,

We enclose our client's offer to settle the whole of the claim under Part 36 in the sum of £450,000 inclusive of interest, our client to pay your client's costs to the date of acceptance. The relevant period is 21 days.

Marcus Thackeray
Thackeray Wolfe LLP

messages.subject: RE: Part 36 offer - HT-2026-000214 [WP save as to costs]
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Marldon have offered £450k - about 21% of the claim. Against counsel's view (70-75% on liability, realistic recovery £1.45m-£1.65m) this is well short. My note recommends we reject and make our own Part 36 around £1.65m to pile on costs pressure. File note to follow for Richard.

Tom Gallagher

Tom Gallagher
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
